title: Adminer sign in page is reachable from the internet
summary: Adminer is an administrative interface and its sign in page answers from the internet.  This proves it is exposed, not that it can be used without a password.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

remediate: Put it behind a VPN or an allow list of networks, or take it off the public site.
